sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ordering_orders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (id > 0), "status_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (status_value IN (0, 1, 2)), "total_minor_units" INTEGER CHECK (total_minor_units IS NULL OR total_minor_units BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "currency_code" TEXT CHECK (currency_code IS NULL OR(currency_code GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' AND currency_code <> 'XXX')), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), "created_at_utc_milliseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at_utc_milliseconds BETWEEN 0 AND 8640000000000000), "placed_at_utc_milliseconds" INTEGER CHECK (placed_at_utc_milliseconds IS NULL OR placed_at_utc_milliseconds BETWEEN 0 AND 8640000000000000), "cancelled_at_utc_milliseconds" INTEGER CHECK (cancelled_at_utc_milliseconds IS NULL OR cancelled_at_utc_milliseconds BETWEEN 0 AND 8640000000000000), CHECK((total_minor_units IS NULL AND currency_code IS NULL)OR(total_minor_units IS NOT NULL AND currency_code IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((status_value = 0 AND placed_at_utc_milliseconds IS NULL AND cancelled_at_utc_milliseconds IS NULL)OR(status_value = 1 AND total_minor_units IS NOT NULL AND currency_code IS NOT NULL AND placed_at_utc_milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at_utc_milliseconds IS NULL)OR(status_value = 2 AND cancelled_at_utc_milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND(placed_at_utc_milliseconds IS NULL OR(total_minor_units IS NOT NULL AND currency_code IS NOT NULL)))));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ordering_order_lines" ("order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ordering_orders(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "catalog_product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (catalog_product_id > 0), "product_title_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(product_title_snapshot) > 0), "unit_price_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price_minor_units BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency_code GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' AND currency_code <> 'XXX'), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "catalog_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (catalog_revision BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), PRIMARY KEY(order_id, catalog_product_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (id > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) > 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (is_active IN (FALSE, TRUE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (id > 0), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) > 0), "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "price_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (price_minor_units BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'XXX' CHECK (currency_code GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), "status_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (status_value IN (0, 1, 2)), "category_id" INTEGER REFERENCES catalog_categories(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), CHECK(status_value = 0 OR(length(description) > 0 AND price_minor_units > 0 AND currency_code <> 'XXX' AND category_id IS NOT NULL)));
